info.title: siso-gen
info.description: One-shot code generator that turns the canonical SISO-REF-010 XML into C# enums for Bowire's DIS plugin (and any downstream project using compatible enum shapes). Install as a .NET tool: `dotnet tool install -g Kuestenlogik.Bowire.Protocol.Dis.SisoGen`, then run `siso-gen --xml SISO-REF-010.xml --out Enums/Generated`.

options.name: --xml
options.description:
Path to the SISO-REF-010 XML document.
Official: https://www.sisostandards.org/page/ReferenceDocuments (login).
Mirror:   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-dis/opendis7-source-generator/master/xml/SISO/SISO-REF-010.xml

options.name: --out
options.description:
Target directory for generated C# enums. Optional when
invoked from inside a Bowire.Protocol.Dis checkout —
then it defaults to src/Kuestenlogik.Bowire.Protocol.Dis/Enumerations/Generated.
